name: Revivify

header.Components: V, S, M (a diamond worth 300+ GP, which the spell consumes)

source.attribution: System Reference Document 5.2.1, Wizards of the Coast LLC; CC BY 4.0.

casting.material: a diamond worth 300+ GP, which the spell consumes

authored_intent: Touch creature dead no more than one minute; consumed 300-GP diamonds; restore to 1 HP; cannot restore old-age death or missing body parts; Gentle Repose adjusts exact deadline.

rules.text: You touch a creature that has died within the last minute.
That creature revives with 1 Hit Point.
This spell can’t revive a creature that has died of old age, nor does it restore any missing body parts.
